title: Avepoint stock climbs following S&P Smallcap 600 inclusion news
summary: Avepoint Inc (NASDAQ:AVPT) shares climbed 4.3% in premarket trading Wednesday following an announcement that the enterprise software provider will join the S&P SmallCap 600 index. S&P Dow Jones Indices revealed the rebalancing move late Tuesday, confirming that AvePoint will replace real estate investment trust LXP Industrial Trust prior to the market open on Monday, Nov. 2.

title: AvePoint Set to Join S&P SmallCap 600
summary: AvePoint Inc. (NASD: AVPT) will replace LXP Industrial Trust (NYSE: LXP) in the S&P SmallCap 600 effective prior to the opening of trading on Monday, November 2. Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board are acquiring LXP Industrial Trust in a deal expected to close soon, pending final closing conditions.
